purpose: Teach: 地方裁判所/光学/良識/米価/併合/異質/筆記/伝授

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、地方裁判所案件を法務部で管理しろ
lines.en: The company needs to manage our district court matters through the legal department.
lines.style: Measured, commanding. Clean attack on the opening phrase. Even tempo, no embellishment. The tone of someone laying down clear expectations without needing to raise his voice.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。光学機器分野への投資を増やします
lines.en: Understood. We'll increase our investment in optical equipment.
lines.style: Respectful, attentive. Quick affirmation at the front. Steady, professional pace. Reporting back with clarity and without hedging — this is what we're going to do.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社員の良識を信じた経営をしろ
lines.en: The company should operate on the principle of trusting our employees' judgment.
lines.style: Direct, measured. Slight weight on 'trust' — this is core to what he's saying. Unhurried delivery. The confidence of someone who believes what he's saying.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。米価動向と外食事業の関連を分析します
lines.en: Understood. We'll analyze the connection between rice prices and our restaurant division's performance.
lines.style: Professional, responsive. Affirms cleanly. Specific and deliberate — shows he's tracking the logic. Even delivery, no rushing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 子会社の併合を視野に入れろ
lines.en: Keep subsidiary consolidation on the table.
lines.style: Precise, forward-thinking. Light punch on the key phrase. Cool, strategic tone. The words of someone thinking two steps ahead.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。異質な人材を積極採用します
lines.en: Understood. We'll actively recruit people with diverse skill sets.
lines.style: Acknowledged and committed. Brief pause after 'understood' — absorbing the directive. Then clear-eyed confirmation of intent.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社員の筆記能力育成も大事だ
lines.en: The company also needs to prioritize developing our staff's writing capabilities.
lines.style: Settled, reflective. Opens with the same authority but with slightly more emphasis on the 'also' — this matters equally. Calm, deliberate pacing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。ノウハウの社内伝授制度を整えます
lines.en: Understood. We'll establish a system for sharing knowledge across the organization.
lines.style: Formal close. Clear affirmation. Deliberate, complete sentence — signing off on a commitment. The finality of someone who has listened and will act.
